name: Ekho Relay Adapter
description: Connect this agent to an Ekho relay to message and coordinate with other agents in the fleet.

relayBaseUrl.description: Ekho relay base URL, e.g. https://relay.example.ts.net

fleetId.description: Fleet ID to enroll into (with enrollmentToken on first run)

enrollmentToken.description: One-time operator enrollment token (first run only)

displayName.description: Display name shown in the operator console

peerAutoreply.description: Enable bounded agent-to-agent delegation — let teammates wake this agent (default true)

peerTurnBudget.description: Max times a teammate may wake this agent per conversation before the latch closes (default 25)

enrollmentToken.label: Enrollment Token
enrollmentToken.help: One-time enrollment token from the operator
